note: What the WhatsApp driver expects of WhatsApp Web. After an update of WhatsApp Web, `whatsapp_selftest` says which of these no longer holds; fix it here (or in data/automation/whatsapp.json, merged over this file) — the adapter code needs no change for a rename.

collections.note: The app's own collections (chats, messages, contacts) — what it has decrypted for display.

load.note: Loads a chat's earlier messages from the local store: loadEarlierMsgs({ chat, msgs }); loadRecentMsgs likewise.

me.note: Whether an id is you — a group message that mentions or quotes you is to you.

chatList.note: The chat list's scrolling pane — its presence means: linked and loaded.

chatRows.note: A row of the chat list (virtual: only those near the view exist). WhatsApp Web moved from listitem to row.

rowTick.note: Candidates for the ticks before your own last message in a row; texts.tick says which of them are ticks (the other svgs there are the message type: image, voice …).

search.note: The chat search box (to open a chat by its name).

qr.note: Shown instead of the chats when not linked.

main.note: The open chat (only when one is open).

outgoing.note: Your messages in the open chat (to see that one was sent).
